title: Ali's Cake
text:
Ali wants to make a cake. He needs three eggs, one cup of milk and some flour. First, he mixes the eggs and the milk in a big bowl. Then he adds the flour and stirs well.

Next, Ali pours the mixture into a pan. He puts the pan in the oven for thirty minutes. His mother helps him check the cake. The cake is soft and warm, and Ali is very happy.

questions.text: How many eggs does Ali need?
How long is the cake in the oven?
Why is Ali happy at the end of the story?
options: He made a cake that tastes good

questions.text: What kind of person is Ali most likely to be?
options: A lazy person who never cooks
A person who likes to cook and learn
A person who is afraid of the oven

paragraph_translations: Ali bir kek yapmak ister. Üç yumurtaya, bir bardak süte ve biraz una ihtiyacı var. Önce yumurtaları ve sütü büyük bir kasede karıştırır. Sonra una ekler ve iyice karıştırır.
Sonra Ali karışımı bir tepsiye döker. Tepsiyi otuz dakika fırına koyar. Annesi keki kontrol etmesine yardım eder. Kek yumuşak ve sıcak, Ali çok mutlu.
